name: Centanafadine
summary: Centanafadine, sold under the brand name Simtriyo, is a medication used for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: Centanafadine is a stimulant and acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI). Its IC50 values for monoamine reuptake inhibition have been reported to be 6 nM for norepinephrine, 38 nM for dopamine, and 83 nM for serotonin.

uses.text: In the United States, centanafadine is indicated for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in adults and children aged six years and older who weigh at least 20 kg. Use is not recommended in children younger than six years, as a higher incidence of weight loss was observed, or in those weighing less than 20 kg, as data is lacking.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects of centanafadine include headache, appetite loss, insomnia, nausea, dry mouth, abdominal pain, and rash, among others.

summaryZh: 賽他發定是一種血清素-去甲腎上腺素-多巴胺再攝取抑制劑（也叫三重再攝取抑制劑），大冢製藥稱為首個獲FDA批准的NDSRI。其被Euthymics Bioscience收購DOV製藥後開始開發。它被開發用於治療注意力缺陷多動障礙，該藥物以1:6:14的比例抑制去甲腎上腺素、多巴胺和血清素的再攝取。
summaryZhHans: 赛他发定是一种血清素-去甲肾上腺素-多巴胺再摄取抑制剂（也叫三重再摄取抑制剂），大冢制药称为首个获FDA批准的NDSRI。其被Euthymics Bioscience收购DOV制药后开始开发。它被开发用于治疗注意力缺陷多动障碍，该药物以1:6:14的比例抑制去甲肾上腺素、多巴胺和血清素的再摄取。
